review.decision: Implement the five independently identified receipt and authorization boundaries
review.notes: Fresh pre-implementation design after the independent request for changes on f8d65090. Preserve the earlier cases. Verify the exact source event and the operator-reviewed scope for existing direct assignments, or a verified user answer and matching cleared question. Never authorize from a body or missing authorship alone. A pause already ingested before reservation must fence the prior reviewed plan. Acknowledging a fetch must retain concrete receipt debt. A prior transport-only receipt must reserve the action without claiming execution or sending again. Only coordination/system prompts are excluded from goal extraction; a human instruction remains a real change.

cases.description: Previously authorized direct assignments and cleared user answers retain a verifiable authority path.
cases.setup: Isolated registered matter, verified HQ review, source event, exact session and question ledger.
cases.action: Arm against a cited direct instruction or cleared answer; vary source identity, event kind, authority citation, newer instruction, user answer and clearance.
cases.expected: Only the exact reviewed instruction or resolved user decision can cover the existing action. No new user message or approval is minted.

cases.description: Acknowledged reply stages and older transport receipts retain concrete execution debt.
cases.setup: Isolated durable source and workspace, existing step, synthetic receipt and fetch.
cases.action: Note a fetch, reopen, ingest received or progress without evidence before arm and reconcile the same action repeatedly.
cases.expected: The original reply and step remain visible. A received or unsupported execution claim cannot discharge work or be replayed. Exact evidence covers the step.

cases.description: An intervening target instruction fences the reviewed plan and the workspace reminder does not masquerade as user authority.
cases.setup: Controlled source cursor and saved responsibility; production prompt classifier with a generated reminder.
cases.action: Ingest target pause before arming at the old revision and test the authenticated action's fixed coordination text against a normal new user prompt.
cases.expected: A consumed pause cannot slip past the reviewed boundary; an explicit fresh review is needed. The coordination echo produces no instruction goal; real user prose still does.
